title: Establish one authoritative LangGraph execution path
objective: Retire the standalone controls.ts execution helpers and make compiled LangGraph the sole runtime authority for declarative graph behavior.

branch.name: wi-0006-authoritative-langgraph-runtime
branch.rationale: The work removes an internal duplicate execution path and migrates samples/tests to the compiled LangGraph runtime.

request.text: Retire the standalone controls.ts runtime, rebuild the remaining path around LangGraph primitives, migrate the sample, and document that LangGraph owns execution.

scope.name: component-adapter
scope.description: Create one generic adapter from trusted GraphComponent port inputs/outputs to LangGraph node state updates.
scope.reason: Graph, loop, and nested-component paths must not each implement their own component invocation semantics.

scope.name: unified-runtime
scope.description: Compile graph and control-loop definitions to one LangGraph-backed runtime shape and remove the separate loop invocation branch.
scope.reason: The CLI and library should execute every declarative graph through one StateGraph path.

scope.name: native-policies
scope.description: Use LangGraph edges, conditional edges, reducers, retryPolicy, timeout, stream events, and Send where the DSL supports the corresponding behavior.
scope.reason: LangGraph must own scheduling and state transition behavior rather than a parallel TypeScript runtime.

scope.name: controls-removal
scope.description: Migrate the conversation sample and tests, then delete src/controls.ts without introducing replacement manual helpers.
scope.reason: The current helper module is the remaining obvious duplicate runtime path.

scope.name: philosophy-documentation
scope.description: Make the compiler/runtime responsibility split explicit in README.md, SKILL.md, and affected sample documentation.
scope.reason: Future contributions need a clear architectural rule against adding another execution engine.

scope.name: evidence
scope.description: Provide provider-free regression, static duplicate-runtime audit, typecheck, build, and CLI evidence.
scope.reason: Deleting a helper path and changing runtime ownership requires repository-wide evidence.

nonGoals.name: dsl-replacement
nonGoals.description: Do not replace YAML/JSON schemas, trusted imports, digest checks, public ports, nested-component encapsulation, or registered implementation restrictions with raw LangGraph JavaScript.
nonGoals.reason: Those are compiler and trust-boundary responsibilities that LangGraph does not provide.

nonGoals.name: durable-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not add checkpoint persistence, interrupt/resume, human approval, durable side-effect receipts, or production tracing backends.
nonGoals.reason: Those capabilities require a separate durable execution contract.

nonGoals.name: provider-release
nonGoals.description: Do not require authenticated live providers or claim production readiness.
nonGoals.reason: Provider-free injected components are sufficient for this refactor's evidence.

nonGoals.name: new-control-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not replace controls.ts with another module that manually implements graph parallelism, mapping, retry, timeout, or traversal.
nonGoals.reason: The purpose of this work is to remove the duplicate runtime, not rename it.

items.name: repository-philosophy
items.description: README.md and operational guidance must state that langgraph-exec is a YAML/JSON compiler and CLI for LangGraph, with LangGraph as the sole authority for graph execution.
items.reason: The architecture must be explicit before the duplicate runtime is removed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Documentation explicitly assigns parsing, validation, trusted imports, bindings, and lowering to this repository and scheduling, state transitions, reducers, routing, retries, timeouts, fan-out, streaming, and runtime events to LangGraph.

items.name: generic-component-adapter
items.description: Trusted components must be invoked through one reusable adapter that resolves declared inputs, validates ports, invokes the component, and returns a LangGraph-compatible state update.
items.reason: Graph and nested/control paths must not duplicate component invocation semantics.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Provider-free tests show the same adapter is used for ordinary graph nodes and nested/control components, with input/output port validation preserved.

items.name: single-compiled-runtime
items.description: Graph and bounded control-loop definitions must compile to and execute through one LangGraph-backed runtime boundary.
items.reason: Separate CompiledLoop and CLI loop execution paths preserve a second runtime model.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The CLI does not branch into a separate loop executor, and public invocation returns through the same compiled graph runtime shape.

items.name: native-execution-policies
items.description: Declarative routes, reducers, loops, retry policies, timeouts, streaming, and supported dynamic fan-out must lower to LangGraph primitives rather than manual runtime helpers.
items.reason: LangGraph must own execution, scheduling, and state transition behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tests demonstrate StateGraph edges/cycles, conditional edges, reducer channels, native retryPolicy, native timeout, stream/task/debug events, and Send where a bounded map contract is implemented.

items.name: controls-deletion
items.description: src/controls.ts and its standalone execution tests must be removed after all consumers migrate; no replacement manual control runtime may be added.
items.reason: The helper module is the remaining duplicate execution path.

acceptanceCriteria.description: No source, sample, test, export, or documentation imports the deleted module, and static inspection finds no equivalent manual Promise.all, Promise.race, retry-loop, or graph-traversal runtime for graph behavior.

items.name: conversation-sample-migration
items.description: The two-LLM conversation sample must express its bounded retry/failure behavior through declarative graph definitions and the compiled LangGraph runtime.
items.reason: The sample currently demonstrates the architecture we are removing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The sample no longer imports retryControl or tryControl, preserves bounded attempts and failure records, and has provider-free regression coverage.

items.name: preserve-compiler-boundaries
items.description: The refactor must preserve YAML/JSON schemas, trusted imports and digests, public ports, nested encapsulation, component registration, LLM provider contracts, and repository-owned semantic budgets.
items.reason: LangGraph execution ownership does not replace application-specific compiler and trust responsibilities.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Existing node, graph, nested graph, import-security, schema, provider-boundary, and bounded-budget tests continue to pass or receive explicit schema/version migration coverage.

items.name: release-evidence
items.description: The work must include deterministic provider-free test, typecheck, build, CLI, static-audit, diff, review, and delivery evidence with explicit non-claims.
items.reason: Removing an internal runtime path affects architecture and public tooling behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The complete suite, typecheck, build, CLI sample checks, and static duplicate-runtime audit pass without claiming live provider, persistence, interrupt/resume, or production readiness.
